snippet.title: Hundreds of Enemies vs Powerful Spells | Defender of Darkness — Official Trailer
snippet.description:
A new dark fantasy tower defense game is coming to Steam

Step into the Dark Lord’s shoes in the demo, out now on Steam with 2 hours of gameplay.

• Face hundreds of attacking enemies
• Use powerful spells to control the battlefield

Master your magic in Defender of Darkness!

Coming this fall!

Wishlist Defender of Darkness on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/4869280/Defender_of_Darkness/

#DefenderOfDarkness #TowerDefense #DarkFantasy #IndieGame
